spell.irons_companions.ice_tornado.guide: Summons an ice tornado of the ancient winds.
spell.irons_companions.stone_spikes.guid: Erupts jagged pillars of rock from beneath your enemies.
spell.irons_companions.heal_ring.guide: Emanates a ring of restorative energy around you.
spell.irons_companions.naginata.guide: Launches a volley of naginatas from the air to strike enemies.
